summary: With Witness B at her marked position the world matches the evidence. Her claim that she "saw the light clearly" and that nothing was between her and the signal is contradicted: the Bus shelter with solid ad panel (SE corner) blocks her line of sight to the signal head at t=6.5s. No further patch is needed; the contradiction is in the testimony.

findings.summary: Witness B could not have seen Signal for northbound Main St (NE corner) from where she marked she was standing.
findings.detail: Her eye-level render at t=6.5s shows the Bus shelter with solid ad panel (SE corner) filling the direction of the signal head. The ray-cast check agrees (blocked by occ_shelter, 22.8 m to the signal). She testified "The light was red for the northbound truck. I am certain of that. I saw it clearly." (Depo 01:50) and that nothing was between her and the signal (Depo 02:20).

evidence.citation: Depo 02:20 ("nothing that I recall" between her and the signal)
